targets.descriptor: Surplice-wrap bodice: the right front panel crosses over the left and its gathers converge into a short run of soft pleats at the left waist seam, where the bodice joins a separate skirt panel, so the sequinned ground visibly changes direction at that join. The embellishment is not uniform — sequins of mixed sizes sit densely on a fine ground that reads slightly open between them, giving a speckled rather than flat metallic field. Sleeves are wide and rounded from the elbow through the forearm and then draw in sharply to a narrow band at the wrist, so the fullness collects just above the hand rather than at the sleeve cap. The opening in the skirt starts high on the front-left, above mid-thigh, and runs to the floor; behind it a smooth, unsequinned paler golden underlayer panel is visible along the whole opening, forming a second visual plane against the sequinned face. The hem reaches the floor and breaks slightly over the foot on the closed side while the slit edge falls straight and forward.

evidence: fine ground cloth carrying dense applied sequins
smooth lightweight underlayer visible through the skirt opening
fine light-returning ground cloth beneath the sequins
